shots.text: The Verdant Deep is a forest of trees as tall as towers. The Deepwood live in the branches. Its Warden, Elowen, sleeps in the oldest tree of all, at Sylvanmere.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Giant trees, rope bridges, glow-moss lighting the roots like streets, Deepwood archers.

shots.text: Elowen had gone mad, and her forest turned on the people who lived in it. Thorns closed the roads. Oaks tore up their roots and walked. Leading them was the Herald Mother Briar, the Deepwood's wisest healer, grown through with thorns.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Black thorns choking the rope bridges; an ancient oak tearing its roots out of the ground and walking; bramble-creatures running ahead. Among them a thicket in the shape of a woman with grey flowers in her hair: Mother Briar.

shots.text: Fennick says green wood rots in the dark of the Rift, so build the void towers. I say build them fast. Those trees are walking toward Fernholt.
shots.speaker: tamsin
shots.art_note: Tamsin at the edge of a root-road, lantern-pole raised, as walking oaks come out of the dark.
